sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Alsager Town on Saturday (KO 15:00), looking to bounce back after a recent loss. Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games and a strong recent record of one loss in their last five, but Alsager are bottom of the table and winless in their last four outings, making this an opportunity for the leaders to reassert themselves.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture where the visitors will be looking to climb away from mid-table after a mixed recent run. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, travel to Eccleshall (sixth, 18 points) in what shapes as a competitive mid-table clash; Eccleshall have won their last game while Bridgnorth have recent losses to overcome. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community at home, with the hosts in form (won their last) while Wednesfield have been erratic. Bilston Town, fifth with 17 points, host Foley Meir (11th, 11 points) in a mid-table affair where Bilston's recent winning streak gives them an edge. Barnton (seventh, 15 points) entertain Shawbury United in a fixture between mid-table teams; Barnton have recent wins while Shawbury are on a significant losing run (six consecutive losses). Market Drayton Town (10th, 12 points) host New Mills (eighth, 14 points) in a mid-table encounter where New Mills come in with recent form. Crewe welcome Allscott Heath on Saturday; Crewe are struggling near the bottom but won last time, while Allscott Heath sit 11th with three wins in their last four. Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town on Saturday; both clubs are in the lower half with poor recent records and limited recent wins between them. Brereton Social face Widnes Town at home on Saturday, with Widnes pointless in their last five games and among the division's bottom sides. Wednesday's midweek fixture sees Brereton Social (11th, 11 points) host Wednesfield Community (ninth, 13 points) at 19:45, a repeat of Saturday's opponent for Wednesfield and a chance for either side to build momentum.
